title: Compute the derivatives
text: Every derivative of $$e^x$$ is $$e^x$$, so every derivative at $$-1$$ equals $$e^{\left(-1\right)}$$.

title: Find the coefficient
text: The coefficient of $$\left(x+1\right)^4$$ is the fourth derivative at $$-1$$ divided by $$24$$, which is $$4$$ factorial. That gives $$\frac{e^{\left(-1\right)}}{24}=\frac{1}{24e}$$.
